summary: Retire the Zippy profile without leaving fleet drift
description: Zippy is a dedicated Telegram vault profile with a unique bot token, its own always-on systemd gateway, 223 copied skills, codebase-memory MCP, one routing entry, 27 stored sessions and no Telegram activity since 2026-07-15. It is still hard-coded into the Bertus overlay fleet policy, queue policy, watchdog cron, reload scripts and systemd enablement. Decommission it reversibly rather than deleting a directory and leaving noisy red monitors.
